When I tried to withdraw the amount from the company account they said my score with company is only 96 and to get at 100 I have to pay 400x4 =1600$ more to be able to withdraw. I realized finally is a tasks scam and closed my account in chime used to make transactions for them. Closed my telegram account even it was my way to communicate with my family in Germany . I have received multiple threatening texts from AE Home Warranty notifying me of a closure; they have my cell phone and text nearly every day to respond or call.

A Middle Aged African American Gentleman that allegedly goes by the name Terrance Jacobs was doing.  door to door sales. The man sold me a $40 bottle of cleaning agent. Claims that it works on everything and bio-safe. etc. but the sale also supports the Youth in Chicago against gang violence. The man was nice, funny and a bit pushy. I bought so he would leave and to do a feel good thing. But after leaving. i immediately searched the info on the bottle and lead me to other people feeling scammed by the same service in the area. This incident occurred in Rockford IL, but they claimed to out from chicago. This appears to be a scam on selling over priced cleaners to support a seemingly non existent charity.
The Cleaning product they are selling is called " Get Gone ".
